summary: Tunnel/agent host script co-locates child_process and HTTP primitives
details: Package dsh-vm-tester 0.1.2 ships agent/tunnel-host.js, which imports Node's child_process module and performs HTTP GET operations. Keyword co-occurrence of child_process and HTTP primitives in a tunnel/agent-style script fired a pattern-match rule, but no traced code path demonstrates installer-side credential reads, environment-variable scraping, hardcoded attacker C2 destinations, or install-time execution of fetched content. The package has no lifecycle scripts invoking this file at install time; the behavior is reachable only when the agent/tunnel host is explicitly launched. The code shape is consistent with a legitimate VM-test tunneling agent that spawns processes and talks HTTP, but the destination endpoints and the data flowing to them have not been verified against first-party infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
